caption:
Standing collection does not stop between headlines. Across river reaches, pipeline corridors, and coastal segments in our area of interest, tasking cycles run on a fixed schedule regardless of whether a given pass shows anything worth a call.

Most passes are quiet. That is the expected output of a working collection plan, not a gap in it. The value sits in the baseline built from months of unremarkable imagery, because that baseline is what makes the one anomalous pass legible in hours instead of days.

We do not publish site-level activity. What we can say: the tasking queue does not idle, and dwell on priority reaches gets reviewed on every cycle, not just when someone asks.
